description: Pull posts from one or more subreddits in bulk (far more than a single listing page), optionally limited to a date window and optionally with each post's comments. Use for building a dataset of a community, trend analysis, or 'what has r/X been discussing since <date>'. Subreddit names only, not post links.

includeCommentThreads.description: Fetch comments under each post (multiplies result count; false for posts only)

name: scrape_subreddit
title: Scrape a subreddit in bulk
